steps.title_el: Με τα μάτια να το λες
steps.title_lat: Me ta matia na to les
steps.album: Με τα μάτια να το λες
steps.mood: Young, shy longing: love signalled with a look, never spoken aloud.
steps.alt: Oil painting: a young Giorgos in three-quarter view under an ember spotlight, oxblood curtains behind him, shadowy figures reaching up out of the smoke and a single candle below.

steps.album: Με τα μάτια να το λες
steps.mood: A young man's declaration of independence: owned by no one.
steps.alt: Oil painting: young Giorgos standing tall in a dark red shirt, broken chains hanging from his wrists, keys and iron bars scattered at his feet, embers glowing behind him.

steps.mood: Aching absence: the empty chair beside you becomes a presence.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos alone at a small cafe table with a candle and a glass of red wine, the chair beside him empty, smoke curling in the dark.

steps.mood: Walking away to save yourself: sorrow mixed with resolve.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos walking out of a dark doorway into the rain with a small suitcase, a lamp glowing by the door and broken keys on the wet stones.

steps.mood: A heart planting its feet: right here, right now, in the thick of it.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos kneeling inside a ring of fire on a church floor, icons glowing on the walls behind him and a column of flame and smoke rising above.

steps.mood: Jealousy as a slow burn, smouldering in the dark.
steps.alt: Oil painting: close portrait of Giorgos with a smouldering gaze, a curtain of flame burning beside him in the darkness.

steps.mood: Swaggering rebellion, a grin covering the wound.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos in a black leather jacket seated on a motorcycle in a smoky night street under a lamp.

steps.mood: At home only after dark: proud, and a little lost.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos standing alone in the dark, looking up into a pillar of warm light, red flowers at his feet.

steps.mood: A playful homage to the old laïko that became his calling card.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos holding a vintage microphone on a night stage under strings of lights, a bouzouki player and listeners around him.

steps.mood: Homesick pride: longing for the streets where it all began.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos on a cobbled harbour street at night, port cranes and lit old houses behind him.

steps.mood: Breathless, runaway love, gone before you can hold on.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos in a long dark coat on a night platform as a lit train streaks past.

steps.mood: A carefree manifesto: living by his own rules.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos on a rocky shore at night, arms flung wide toward the breaking sea, a lit town across the water.

steps.mood: Cheeky, glittering fun, a wink at glamour.
steps.alt: Oil painting: a laughing Giorgos in a crowded club under a shower of rose petals and flying plates, a woman in a gold sequined dress dancing beside him.

steps.mood: Saturday night rushing into the city, a finished love keeping pace.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos standing on a city street at night, headlights streaking past behind him.

steps.mood: Still awake at four in the morning, unwilling to go home to the silence.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos in a closed cafe late at night, chin on his hand beside a glass of wine, a clock on the wall and faint angel wings in the shadows.

steps.mood: Pure summer joy: sea, dancing and warm Greek nights.
steps.alt: Oil painting: a barefoot Giorgos dancing along the shore of a white island village at night under strings of lights, friends dancing behind him.

steps.mood: Tender, grown-up longing: a warm ache rather than a wound.
steps.alt: Oil painting: an older Giorgos in his knitted cap leaning on a balcony rail at night, looking out at a lit ship on a dark sea, an angel in the lamplight.

steps.mood: Heavy nights, carried with quiet stoicism.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos in a dark coat on a rocky shore under a full moon, one hand pressed to his chest.

steps.mood: A plea at the door: do not go anywhere.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos reaching out from a doorway toward a figure walking away down a lamplit wet alley, bright wings of light between them.

steps.mood: A dark night of the soul, as though God has stepped out of the room.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos looking up beneath a carved Epitaphios canopy of white, red and violet flowers, an icon of Christ and a lit lamp in the dark behind.

steps.mood: Battered resilience: worse has already been survived.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos braced in a wooden boat, hauling a rope in a storm, an angel of light rising over the sea.

steps.mood: Drawing the line: a love story finished, no going back.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos beside a blue sea at dawn, letting pages fly from his hand into the wind.

steps.mood: A proud and playful no to other people's rules.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos glancing back over his shoulder on a palm-lined seafront at dawn, an angel in the pale sky.

steps.mood: When words stop and you simply listen to the heart.
steps.alt: Oil painting: close portrait of Giorgos with his eyes closed and a hand at his cheek, listening, a rose-gold angel beside him over the sea.

steps.mood: Love at full blaze, sung as total surrender.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos with arms spread wide above a crowd of raised hands, engulfed in golden fire, seraphim and angels blazing above him.

steps.mood: Hope against the dark: waiting every day for a miracle.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos standing in the sea at sunrise with open hands, red six-winged seraphim in the burning sky.

steps.mood: A sleepless vigil, heart open until the day breaks.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos behind the counter of a lit all-night kiosk at dawn, an angel hovering above the rooftops.

steps.mood: Drowning a heartache, with a streak of self-mocking humour.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos leaning back and laughing on a rooftop ledge beside a bottle, a tall angel of light behind him over the city.

steps.mood: A zeibekiko of the small hours, danced with defiant abandon.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos dancing a zeibekiko, one knee down and arms spread on a shipyard slipway, a ship behind him and red seraphim in a sky of fire.

steps.mood: An urgent call to dance right now, Greek and Persian in one party.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos dancing among clouds with musicians and dancers in traditional dress, seraphim in the golden light above.

steps.mood: Climbing out of a private hell, with angels at his side.
steps.alt: Oil painting: an angel in white takes Giorgos by the wrist and lifts him out of smoke and rubble toward the light.

steps.mood: Wide, reflective calm, open as the sea.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos on a cliff edge, looking out over a luminous white sea, angels faint in the bright sky.

steps.mood: His last word: breaking, and being stitched back together.
steps.alt: Oil painting: Giorgos in a torn shirt mended with gold, reaching up toward a hand of light that reaches down to him.
